pr_title: Fix handling of non-integer port values in community_id processor

issue_context.title: Community_id processor expects ports to be integers rather than long
issue_context.body:
The new `community_id` ingest pipeline processor expects all ports to be `integers`, however any numerical value in an ingest pipeline defaults to a `long`.

When trying to use the `community_id` processor without converting the `source/destination` fields, you will get this hard to track error message:

`"class java.lang.Long cannot be cast to class java.lang.Integer (java.lang.Long and java.lang.Integer are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')"`

review_comments: What's the purpose of this change?
Huh, okay, looked into it -- it'd be a runtime exception if `o` is a `Long`. TIL!
